_doc: Globals whose module ends with Object.freeze(<global>) — tests/unit/frozen-globals.test.mjs asserts each still does, and that the accumulator/descriptor targets in `mutable` never are. Regenerate the candidate list with the freeze scanner (see the test header) after adding a module. `Tracks` and `TrackGeom` stay open because the VM harnesses instrument them (verify-track.cjs defines `_vmContext`/`_vmConsole` on Tracks; track-build-vm.cjs wraps every TrackGeom emitter for the parity and foundation tests). The rest of `mutable` are TEST SEAMS a spec or tool monkeypatches at runtime (a frozen module makes the sloppy-mode assignment a silent no-op, so the spec measures nothing): NetTransport (net-authority injects prefetchIce), AiDrive (tests/specs/physics-hotpath.spec.js wraps its ctx entry points), Car3D (parts-physics / parts-mesh-cache / custom-team specs replace build, buildWheel, buildWheelLayers and bodyAnchors), F1API (tests/specs/telemetry-compare.spec.js stubs every fetcher), GLTF (tests/specs/parts-physics.spec.js stubs toMesh), GameAudio (tests/specs/audio-smoke.spec.js replaces startMusic), Input (tests/specs/understeer-cue.spec.js records rumble), LampChunks (tools/gfx/chunk-share-census.mjs wraps resolve). Scan before freezing anything: alias-aware search of tests/ and tools/ for `<global>.<name> =`, `<alias>[k] =`, Object.assign/defineProperty on it.
